Executive presence and sound judgment

Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real\-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

  

Valeris is seeking a Director, IT Project Management Office (PMO) \& Technology Transformation to lead a small IT PMO while personally serving as the lead Project Manager on two of the company's largest active technology transformation initiatives. This is a dual\-mandate role: roughly ¼ PMO leadership (governance, standards, reporting, and a small team of project managers) and ¾ hands\-on delivery leadership of complex, cross\-functional programs.

  

The ideal candidate has run enterprise\-scale technology transformation programs, can stand up lightweight\-but\-effective PMO governance, and is equally comfortable in the boardroom translating program status for executives and in the weeds with workstream leads resolving a blocked dependency. This role reports to the VP, IT Technology Business Management, and partners closely with IT leadership, business sponsors, and external implementation partners.

**IT PMO Leadership**

* Manage a lean, right\-sized IT PMO — establishing governance routines and consistent project management standards across the IT project portfolio.
* Define and maintain PMO methodology, templates, and tools (status reporting, RAID logs, stage\-gate/change control) appropriate to project size and risk.
* Manage, coach, and develop a small team of project managers; assign and balance workload across the active IT project portfolio.
* Own portfolio\-level reporting — consolidated status dashboards, risk/issue heatmaps, and executive summaries for IT and business leadership.
* Partner with the VP, IT Technology Business Management to align the IT project portfolio with budget, resource capacity, and business priorities.
* Drive continuous improvement of PMO processes based on lessons learned and delivery outcomes across the portfolio.

 **Program/Project Management — IT Transformation Initiatives**

* Serve as the lead Project Manager for two large, concurrent technology transformation initiatives, each spanning multiple workstreams (e.g., CRM, Portals, Integrations, Data and Analytics, Data Migration, etc.).
* Develop and maintain comprehensive implementation plans and timelines, including technical systems, infrastructure, data migration, communications, and process alignment.
* Translate executive sponsor goals into clear transformation roadmaps aligned to business outcomes, operational scalability, and growth.
* Track and update project milestones, proactively identify bottlenecks and dependencies, and escalate risks to senior leadership with recommended mitigations.
* Facilitate regular status meetings and steering committee sessions; prepare and distribute agendas, decisions, action items, and follow\-ups.
* Maintain issues\-and\-decisions registries, documenting owners, decisions, and deadlines across both initiatives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (IT, security, operations, finance) and external vendors/consultants supporting each initiative.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and security standards, coordinating audits and control validation as needed.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews, capturing lessons learned and measuring success against defined outcomes/KPIs.
* Act as a strategic integrator across both initiatives — breaking down silos, managing interdependencies between the two programs, and keeping delivery outcome\-driven.
* Perform additional tasks or projects as assigned

 **Valeris Values**

* Utilize Valeris’ values as the driving force behind the team’s success
* On time adherence to training deadlines for all corporate policies and procedures
* Ensure all SOPs are followed with consistency

**What you'll need to thrive in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field; PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification preferred.
* 12\+ years of progressive project/program management experience, including experience managing a PMO and a team of project managers.
* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale technology or business transformation initiatives (e.g., CRM implementations, M\&A integrations, platform migrations) from planning through post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Experience building or maturing PMO governance — intake, prioritization, status reporting, and stage\-gate processes — in a matrixed organization.
* Familiarity with enterprise technical systems and architectures such as Salesforce, Genesys, PrimeRx, HRIS, data migration, and cloud/SaaS platforms.
* Proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Asana, Jira, or ServiceNow).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting program status to senior/executive leadership.
* Strong influencing ability — guides without formal authority and secures stakeholder buy\-in

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using advanced 2nm and 3nm process nodes with state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using advanced 2nm and 3nm process nodes with state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.
